verdict.rationale: Tavily's Extract endpoint explicitly supports pulling content from 'one or more specified URLs' in a single call, and Crawl/Map traverse many pages of a site at once, giving some bulk-processing capability. However there's no documented batch/bulk search endpoint, and rate-limit tiers (100–1,000 RPM) constrain large-scale bulk use. Missing for 10: a dedicated bulk/batch search API, explicit bulk-item limits or pagination guidance, and independent evidence of large-scale bulk usage in production.
